verdict.rationale: Qodo automatically reviews every pull request with severity-ranked, actionable findings and full-codebase context. Its governance layer enforces standards across every repository at scale without manual intervention, and blast-radius risk labels help triage which PRs need human attention. The Agentic Toolbox (CLI, MCP, and Claude Code/Codex/Kiro plugins) brings these review capabilities into coding agents so agent-authored changes are checked before a PR is opened. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing review of AI/agent-generated PRs at high volume, and independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality and throughput at scale.
